verdict.rationale: AMD provides extensive first-party docs and tooling (Ryzen AI Software, Quark quantization, ONNX Runtime/Vitis AI EP, Lemonade SDK, GAIA agent framework, AI Analyzer) plus official OS support (Windows, RHEL, Ubuntu), indicating a real developer ecosystem. However, community evidence shows friction points (ROCm docs fragmented across multiple projects, memory-bandwidth bottlenecks limiting real-world LLM throughput, missing ECC reporting on 'Pro' SKUs, and complaints about incomplete/unhelpful benchmarking) suggesting the ecosystem is still maturing rather than unquestionably tier-one. Missing for 10: independent compiler/toolchain maturity benchmarks, mainline Linux kernel/driver support evidence, and third-party corroboration that optimization guidance matches other tier-one architectures (x86/ARM).
